title: Studio Accounting Method for the Option Deposit Due on a Design Studio Selections File
content:
**1. Option deposit due.** The option deposit due on the Design Studio Selections file is the line deposit, reduced by the lender relief percent, plus every studio fee line and every change order fee in full, less the option deposits held on the file, never below zero. The lender relief percent is zero. The lender relief percent is applied to the line deposit after the ladder and option cap comparison in section 3, rounded half up to the cent, and never to the studio fee lines or the change order fees.

**2. Line deposit.** The line deposit is the sum of three group deposits, each rounded half up to the cent:

- *structural group* — the structural, electrical and plumbing lines less the removal credits booked on lines of those categories, never below zero, at the structural deposit percent, which is the package's structural deposit percent;
- *long-lead group* — the cabinetry and countertop lines added while the agreement's construction stage was foundation or framing, less the long-lead removal credits, never below zero, at the long-lead deposit percent, which is the finish deposit percent;
- *finish group* — every other cabinetry, countertop, flooring, appliance and exterior line, less the removal credits booked on those lines other than the long-lead removal credits, and less the credit offset, never below zero, at the finish deposit percent, which is the package's finish deposit percent.

The long-lead removal credits are the removal credits booked on cabinetry and countertop lines while the agreement's construction stage was foundation or framing, whenever those lines were added. The construction stage of a line is the stage shown on its own selection or removal entry. The credit offset is the design credit already applied to option lines on the file.

**3. Ladder and option cap.** Where the file's option total exceeds the package's deposit ladder threshold, no deposit percent used for a group is below the package's elevated ladder percent; and the line deposit is never less than the part of the file's option total above the package's option cap percent of the agreement's base price. The option total is the figure shown on the file; the base price is that of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves.

**4. Lines taken in full.** Studio fee lines are the design consultation fee, package fee, card convenience fee and returned payment fee lines; change order fees are the fees on the change order entries. The option deposits held are the deposits-held figure of the file. The due amount is rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked figures (hypothetical package: structural 50 percent, finish 25 percent, ladder threshold 75000.00, elevated 50 percent, option cap 18 percent; base price 500000.00)**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Structural lines 10000.00, no removals: 50 percent | 5000.00 |
| Long-lead lines: none | 0.00 |
| Finish lines 20000.00, less removal credits 2000.00, less credit applied 1500.00, that is 16500.00 at 25 percent | 4125.00 |
| Line deposit (option total 28750.00 does not exceed 75000.00; part above the 90000.00 cap: none) | 9125.00 |
| Studio fee lines 300.00 and change order fees 450.00, in full | 750.00 |
| Less option deposits held | 6000.00 |
| Option deposit due | 3875.00 |

Equal to the ladder threshold is not above it: an option total of exactly 75000.00 leaves each group at its own percent, while 75000.01 raises the finish group to 50 percent.
